name: Alex Sutherland
title: Counsellor & Sex Therapist
description: Alex (she/her) is a queer and neurodivergent qualified Counsellor with over 9 years experience in mental health settings. Counselling and Sex Therapy based in Brunswick for individuals and/or partners to talk openly and safely. We are trauma-informed, gender-affirming, neuro-affirming, poly and kink-friendly.
specialties: Sex therapy, Relationship counselling, Sexual pain and dysfunction, LGBTIQA+, Kink, Polyamory, Gender-affirming, Trauma-informed

name: Kevin Vun
title: Psychotherapist / Counsellor / Relationship Therapist
description: A sex-positive therapist online and in Melbourne; queer-led, BIPOC-owned, kink-aware, and culturally responsive. Kink-aware and fetish-friendly; LGBTQIA+ affirming therapy & gay counselling. Supports individuals navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, identity, cultural transitions, and personal growth. EMDR: Level 1 & 2.
specialties: Sex therapy, Intimacy coaching, LGBTQIA+ affirming therapy, Gay counselling, Kink-friendly, Trauma, PTSD, EMDR, Asian mental health

name: Daniel Di Pietro
title: Sexologist / Psychotherapist (PACFA)
description: Daniel is a sexologist and psychotherapist who enjoys working empathically and collaboratively with individuals and partnerships, and he specialises in working with sexological presentations around male sexual health. Works with sexual and gender identity, intimacy, pleasure, desire discrepancy, kink and fetish-related behaviours.
specialties: Sexology, Male sexual health, Gender and sexual identity, Desire discrepancy, Kink and fetish

name: Rose Martinovic
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Being queer, trans, non-binary, ace, or anywhere on the LGBTQIA+ spectrum can be joyful. I offer trans-affirming therapy and work with people across all stages of gender exploration. I work affirmatively with clients in polyamorous, open, queerplatonic, and/or kink dynamics. Healing from religious, cultural, or systemic trauma.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Trans-affirming therapy, Gender exploration, Polyamory, Kink, Trauma
